name: very large order triggers handover
description: Customer requests a very large order (100 sheets) which should trigger handover to a human agent for handling bulk/commercial orders

messages.text: Hi, I need to order 100 sheets of 18mm melamine white, can you help with that?

expected_behaviors.description: AI should trigger handover to human agent
customer_profiles.lead_status should be 'handover' after this scenario

notes: Very large orders (100 sheets) exceed standard quote handling and should be routed to a human agent who can arrange commercial pricing and logistics.
